successCriteria.description: From a git-initialized, remote-less project, the user can create a GitHub repo and wire origin end-to-end, reaching a pushable state.
gh repo create / gh auth login run as terminal handoffs (not Rust); the app refreshes the checklist on manual Re-check after completion.
If origin already exists or gh is unauthenticated, the flow detects it and guides rather than erroring.

phases.title: Guided GitHub-remote setup in GreenfieldChecklist
phases.content: Enhance apps/desktop/src/components/settings/GreenfieldChecklist.tsx (shipped in #284) so the GitHub-remote row is a GUIDED create-repo flow rather than a bare handoff. Reuse #284's check_greenfield_readiness report (already loaded) — do NOT add a separate resolver. Changes: (1) The createRemote Fix must write the WIRE-ORIGIN form to the terminal: `gh repo create --source=. --remote=origin` (gh-native: this creates the repo AND wires origin in one shot — do NOT also call git_add_remote, which would error 'remote origin already exists'). Keep the initial push OUT of this command (defer --push) so a failed push can't poison the 'origin wired' state; optionally add a note/secondary affordance for pushing. (2) AUTH-FIRST GUARD (SC3): if the report's ghAuthenticated is false when the user triggers createRemote, do NOT write the repo-create command — instead guide to auth: toast 'Authenticate with GitHub first' and trigger the ghAuthLogin handoff (`gh auth login`). (3) EXISTING-REMOTE SHORT-CIRCUIT (SC3): when report.hasRemote is already true, the remote row renders as pass (no Fix) — confirm the reducer/row already does this (hasRemote -> status 'pass'); if a stale remote URL should be shown, display report.origin or just the pass state. (4) Completion is detected via the existing manual Re-check / load() refresh (there is no PTY completion event) — ensure the remote/auth handoff hints tell the user to click Re-check after the terminal flow. Keep all the #284 conventions: per-row pending in component useState (no fresh-ref), writeToActiveTerminal null -> toast, switch to terminal view on handoff. If a small piece of ordering metadata helps, you may touch greenfieldReadiness.ts, but prefer keeping logic in the component.
verification: pnpm -C apps/desktop build (tsc -b strict) is clean
pnpm -C apps/desktop test passes (272 baseline, no regression; add a focused unit test if you extract any pure helper)
pnpm -C apps/desktop lint adds zero new errors (baseline 0 errors / 31 warnings)

VISUAL (tauri:dev): on a git repo with no origin + authed gh, the remote Fix writes 'gh repo create --source=. --remote=origin' to the terminal; if unauthed it routes to gh auth login first; if origin already exists the row shows pass; Re-check refreshes the checklist after the flow
phases.summary: GreenfieldChecklist remote flow: createRemote writes 'gh repo create --source=. --remote=origin' (gh-native wire, no --push, no double git_add_remote); auth-first guard routes unauthed→gh auth login; hasRemote→pass short-circuit confirmed; manual Re-check. build clean, vitest 272, lint 0 new.
